# Boundary condition handling\\\\n    if bctype == 'reflect':\\\\n        x_filt = np.concatenate([x[:N, :], x], axis=0)\\\\n        trim = N\\\\n    elif bctype == 'zeropad':\\\\n        x_filt = np.concatenate([np.zeros((N, x.shape[1])), x], axis=0)\\\\n        trim = N\\\\n    else:\\\\n        x_filt = x.copy()\\\\n        trim = 0\\\\n\\\\n    # Gaussian kernel (matching MATLAB gausswin)\\\\n    kern = windows.gaussian(N, std=(N-1)/(2*2.5))  # MATLAB gausswin default alpha=2.5\\\\n\\\\n    # Make causal: zero out first half\\\\n    kern[:N//2] = 0\\\\n    kern = kern / kern.sum()\\\\n\\\\n    # Convolve\\\\n    out = np.zeros_like(x_filt)\\\\n    for j in range(x_filt.shape[1]):\\\\n        out[:, j] = np.convolve(x_filt[:, j], kern, mode='same')\\\\n\\\\n    out = out[trim:, :]\\\\n\\\\n    if was_1d:\\\\n        out = out[:, 0]\\\\n    return out\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef read_h5_string(f, ref):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Read a string from an HDF5 object reference.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    val = f[ref]\\\\n    chars = np.array(val).flatten()\\\\n    return ''.join(chr(int(c)) for c in chars)\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef get_cluster_qualities(f, clu_group):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Get quality labels for all clusters in a probe's cluster group.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    quality_refs = clu_group['quality']\\\\n    n_clusters = quality_refs.shape[0]\\\\n    qualities = []\\\\n    for i in range(n_clusters):\\\\n        ref = quality_refs[i, 0]\\\\n        q = read_h5_string(f, ref)\\\\n        qualities.append(q.strip().lower())\\\\n    return qualities\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef get_spike_data(f, clu_group, clu_idx):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Get spike trial numbers and trial times for a specific cluster.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    trial_ref = clu_group['trial'][clu_idx, 0]\\\\n    trial = np.array(f[trial_ref]).flatten()\\\\n\\\\n    trialtm_ref = clu_group['trialtm'][clu_idx, 0]\\\\n    trialtm = np.array(f[trialtm_ref]).flatten()\\\\n\\\\n    return trial, trialtm\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef compute_video_offset(f, obj):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Compute video offset matching findVideoOffset.m.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    bitStart = np.array(obj['bp']['ev']['bitStart']).flatten()\\\\n    sglx_bitstart = np.array(obj['sglx']['bitcode']['bitstart']).flatten()\\\\n    sglx_fs = float(np.array(obj['sglx']['fs']).flatten()[0])\\\\n\\\\n    bitStart_mode = float(stats.mode(bitStart, keepdims=False).mode)\\\\n    sglx_bitstart_mode = float(stats.mode(sglx_bitstart, keepdims=False).mode)\\\\n\\\\n    vidshift = sglx_bitstart_mode / sglx_fs - bitStart_mode\\\\n    return vidshift\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef get_traj_feature_names(f, traj_group, trial_idx=0):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Get feature names from trajectory data.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    feat_ref = traj_group['featNames'][trial_idx, 0]\\\\n    feat_data = f[feat_ref]\\\\n    names = []\\\\n    # Could be (1, n_feats) or (n_feats, 1)\\\\n    if feat_data.shape[0] == 1:\\\\n        for i in range(feat_data.shape[1]):\\\\n            ref = feat_data[0, i]\\\\n            names.append(read_h5_string(f, ref))\\\\n    else:\\\\n        for i in range(feat_data.shape[0]):\\\\n            ref = feat_data[i, 0]\\\\n            names.append(read_h5_string(f, ref))\\\\n    return names\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef compute_velocity_from_traj(f, traj_group, trial_idx, feat_idx, n_timepoints, gocue_time, vidshift, time_axis):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    Compute velocity of a tracked feature for a trial, interpolated to time_axis.\\\\n    Returns velocity as a 1D array aligned to time_axis.\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    # Get frame times\\\\n    ft_ref = traj_group['frameTimes'][trial_idx, 0]\\\\n    frame_times = np.array(f[ft_ref]).flatten()\\\\n\\\\n    # Get tracking data: shape (n_features, 3, n_frames) where 3=[x,y,conf]\\\\n    ts_ref = traj_group['ts'][trial_idx, 0]\\\\n    ts = np.array(f[ts_ref])\\\\n\\\\n    # ts shape from HDF5 is (n_feats, 3, n_frames)\\\\n    x = ts[feat_idx, 0, :]  # x coordinate\\\\n    y = ts[feat_idx, 1, :]  # y coordinate\\\\n\\\\n    # Fill missing values with nearest (matching methods: \\\\\\\"Missing values were filled in\\\\n    # with the nearest available value for all features, except for the tongue\\\\\\\")\\\\n    # For tongue, we don't fill - but for velocity calculation we need to handle NaNs\\\\n\\\\n    # Compute velocity as first-order derivative\\\\n    # Velocity = sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2) / dt\\\\n    dt_vid = 1.0 / VIDEO_FPS\\\\n    dx = np.diff(x)\\\\n    dy = np.diff(y)\\\\n    vel = np.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2) / dt_vid\\\\n    vel_times = frame_times[:-1] + dt_vid / 2  # midpoint times\\\\n\\\\n    # Align to go cue: subtract vidshift and gocue_time\\\\n    vel_times_aligned = vel_times - vidshift - gocue_time\\\\n\\\\n    # Interpolate to time_axis\\\\n    try:\\\\n        vel_interp = np.interp(time_axis, vel_times_aligned, vel, left=np.nan, right=np.nan)\\\\n    except:\\\\n        vel_interp = np.full(len(time_axis), np.nan)\\\\n\\\\n    return vel_interp\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef load_motion_energy(data_dir, anm, date):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Load motion energy data from .mat file.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    me_fn = f'motionEnergy_{anm}_{date}.mat'\\\\n    me_path = os.path.join(DATA_ROOT, data_dir, me_fn)\\\\n\\\\n    if not os.path.exists(me_path):\\\\n        return None, None\\\\n\\\\n    try:\\\\n        me_mat = sio.loadmat(me_path, squeeze_me=True, struct_as_record=False)\\\\n        me = me_mat['me']\\\\n        return me.data, me.moveThresh\\\\n    except:\\\\n        try:\\\\n            me_f = h5py.File(me_path, 'r')\\\\n            me = me_f['me']\\\\n            thresh = float(np.array(me['moveThresh']).flatten()[0])\\\\n            data_refs = me['data']\\\\n            me_data = []\\\\n            for i in range(data_refs.shape[0]):\\\\n                ref = data_refs[i, 0]\\\\n                d = np.array(me_f[ref]).flatten()\\\\n                me_data.append(d)\\\\n            me_f.close()\\\\n            return me_data, thresh\\\\n        except:\\\\n            return None, None\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef interpolate_me_to_time_axis(me_trial, frame_times, vidshift, gocue_time, time_axis):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Interpolate motion energy to time_axis, aligned to go cue.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    ft_aligned = frame_times - vidshift - gocue_time\\\\n    try:\\\\n        me_interp = np.interp(time_axis, ft_aligned, me_trial, left=np.nan, right=np.nan)\\\\n    except:\\\\n        me_interp = np.full(len(time_axis), np.nan)\\\\n    return me_interp\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n# ============================================================\\\\n# Main processing\\\\n# ============================================================\\\\n\\\\ndef process_session(anm, date, probe_nums, data_dir, time_edges, time_axis):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    Process a single session. Returns dict with neural, input, output data per trial,\\\\n    or None if session doesn't meet criteria.\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    fn = f'data_structure_{anm}_{date}.mat'\\\\n    fpath = os.path.join(DATA_ROOT, data_dir, fn)\\\\n\\\\n    if not os.path.exists(fpath):\\\\n        print(f'  WARNING: File not found: {fpath}')\\\\n        return None\\\\n\\\\n    print(f'  Loading {anm}_{date} (probes {probe_nums})...')\\\\n\\\\n    f = h5py.File(fpath, 'r')\\\\n    obj = f['obj']\\\\n    bp = obj['bp']\\\\n\\\\n    # === Extract trial info ===\\\\n    ntrials = int(np.array(bp['Ntrials']).flatten()[0])\\\\n    hit = np.array(bp['hit']).flatten().astype(bool)\\\\n    miss = np.array(bp['miss']).flatten().astype(bool)\\\\n    no = np.array(bp['no']).flatten().astype(bool)\\\\n    R = np.array(bp['R']).flatten().astype(bool)\\\\n    L = np.array(bp['L']).flatten().astype(bool)\\\\n    autowater = np.array(bp['autowater']).flatten()\\\\n    early = np.array(bp['early']).flatten().astype(bool)\\\\n    stim_enable = np.array(bp['stim']['enable']).flatten().astype(bool)\\\\n\\\\n    gocue = np.array(bp['ev']['goCue']).flatten()\\\\n\\\\n    # === Trial selection (matching reference code conditions) ===\\\\n    # Include: hit or miss trials, no stim, no early lick\\\\n    # Exclude: ignore trials (no response), stim trials, early lick trials\\\\n    # Conditions from code:\\\\n    #   'R&hit&~stim.enable&~autowater&~early'  -> right correct DR\\\\n    #   'L&hit&~stim.enable&~autowater&~early'  -> left correct DR\\\\n    #   'R&miss&~stim.enable&~autowater&~early' -> right error DR\\\\n    #   'L&miss&~stim.enable&~autowater&~early' -> left error DR\\\\n    #   'R&hit&~stim.enable&autowater&~early'   -> right correct WC\\\\n    #   'L&hit&~stim.enable&autowater&~early'   -> left correct WC\\\\n    # We include all hit and miss trials (not ignore/no), excluding stim and early\\\\n    valid_trials = (hit | miss) & ~stim_enable & ~early\\\\n    valid_idx = np.where(valid_trials)[0]\\\\n\\\\n    if len(valid_idx) < 5:\\\\n        print(f'  WARNING: Too few valid trials ({len(valid_idx)}), skipping')\\\\n        f.close()\\\\n        return None\\\\n\\\\n    # === Extract cluster data from specified probes ===\\\\n    clu_ref = obj['clu']\\\\n    all_spike_trials = []\\\\n    all_spike_trialtm = []\\\\n    all_qualities = []\\\\n\\\\n    for probe_num in probe_nums:\\\\n        probe_idx = probe_num - 1  # 0-indexed\\\\n        try:\\\\n            ref = clu_ref[probe_idx, 0]\\\\n            clu_group = f[ref]\\\\n            if not isinstance(clu_group, h5py.Group):\\\\n                print(f'  WARNING: Probe {probe_num} has no cluster data, skipping probe')\\\\n                continue\\\\n        except:\\\\n            print(f'  WARNING: Cannot access probe {probe_num}, skipping probe')\\\\n            continue\\\\n\\\\n        qualities = get_cluster_qualities(f, clu_group)\\\\n        n_clu = len(qualities)\\\\n\\\\n        for i in range(n_clu):\\\\n            q = qualities[i]\\\\n            if q in EXCLUDE_QUALITIES:\\\\n                continue\\\\n            trial, trialtm = get_spike_data(f, clu_group, i)\\\\n            all_spike_trials.append(trial)\\\\n            all_spike_trialtm.append(trialtm)\\\\n            all_qualities.append(q)\\\\n\\\\n    if len(all_spike_trials) == 0:\\\\n        print(f'  WARNING: No valid clusters found, skipping')\\\\n        f.close()\\\\n        return None\\\\n\\\\n    n_units = len(all_spike_trials)\\\\n\\\\n    # === Align spikes to go cue and bin ===\\\\n    n_timebins = len(time_axis)\\\\n\\\\n    # Single trial firing rates: (n_units, n_timebins, n_trials)\\\\n    trialdat = np.zeros((n_units, n_timebins, ntrials))\\\\n\\\\n    for i in range(n_units):\\\\n        trial_nums = all_spike_trials[i]\\\\n        spike_times = all_spike_trialtm[i]\\\\n\\\\n        for j in range(ntrials):\\\\n            trial_mask = (trial_nums == (j + 1))  # trials are 1-indexed in MATLAB\\\\n            if not np.any(trial_mask):\\\\n                continue\\\\n\\\\n            spk_times = spike_times[trial_mask]\\\\n            # Align to go cue\\\\n            aligned_times = spk_times - gocue[j]\\\\n\\\\n            # Bin spikes\\\\n            counts, _ = np.histogram(aligned_times, bins=time_edges)\\\\n            # Convert to firing rate and smooth\\\\n            fr = counts / DT\\\\n            fr_smooth = causal_gaussian_smooth(fr, SMOOTH_WINDOW, BC_TYPE)\\\\n            trialdat[i, :, j] = fr_smooth\\\\n\\\\n    # === Remove low firing rate units ===\\\\n    # Mean FR across all time bins and all trials (matching removeLowFRClusters.m)\\\\n    # The reference computes mean of the PSTH (trial-averaged), but we approximate\\\\n    # by computing mean across all time and trials\\\\n    mean_frs = np.mean(np.mean(trialdat[:, :, valid_idx], axis=2), axis=1)\\\\n    keep_units = mean_frs > LOW_FR_THRESH\\\\n\\\\n    if keep_units.sum() < 10:\\\\n        print(f'  WARNING: Only {keep_units.sum()} units with FR > {LOW_FR_THRESH} Hz (need >= 10), skipping')\\\\n        f.close()\\\\n        return None\\\\n\\\\n    trialdat = trialdat[keep_units, :, :]\\\\n    n_units_final = trialdat.shape[0]\\\\n    print(f'  {n_units_final} units after filtering (from {n_units} total)')\\\\n\\\\n    # === Compute video offset ===\\\\n    vidshift = compute_video_offset(f, obj)\\\\n\\\\n    # === Load trajectory data for tongue and paw velocity ===\\\\n    traj_ref = obj['traj']\\\\n\\\\n    # Bottom cam for tongue and paw\\\\n    bottom_ref = traj_ref[1, 0]\\\\n    bottom_traj = f[bottom_ref]\\\\n    bottom_feats = get_traj_feature_names(f, bottom_traj, 0)\\\\n    # Find tongue feature index (top_tongue) and paw feature index (top_paw or bottom_paw)\\\\n    tongue_feat_idx = None\\\\n    paw_feat_idx = None\\\\n    for idx, name in enumerate(bottom_feats):\\\\n        if name == 'top_tongue':\\\\n            tongue_feat_idx = idx\\\\n        if name == 'bottom_paw':\\\\n            paw_feat_idx = idx\\\\n    if tongue_feat_idx is None:\\\\n        # Fall back to any tongue feature\\\\n        for idx, name in enumerate(bottom_feats):\\\\n            if 'tongue' in name.lower():\\\\n                tongue_feat_idx = idx\\\\n                break\\\\n    if paw_feat_idx is None:\\\\n        for idx, name in enumerate(bottom_feats):\\\\n            if 'paw' in name.lower():\\\\n                paw_feat_idx = idx\\\\n                break\\\\n\\\\n    # === Load motion energy ===\\\\n    me_data, me_thresh = load_motion_energy(data_dir, anm, date)\\\\n\\\\n    # === Process each valid trial ===\\\\n    neural_trials = []\\\\n    input_trials = []\\\\n    output_trials = []\\\\n    trial_indices_used = []\\\\n\\\\n    for trial_idx in valid_idx:\\\\n        # Neural data for this trial\\\\n        neural = trialdat[:, :, trial_idx]  # (n_units, n_timebins)\\\\n\\\\n        # Input: time from go cue (same for all trials)\\\\n        input_data = time_axis.reshape(1, -1).copy()  # (1, n_timebins)\\\\n\\\\n        # === Output variables ===\\\\n        # Lick direction: left=0, right=1\\\\n        lick_dir = 1 if R[trial_idx] else 0\\\\n\\\\n        # Behavioral context: WC=0, DR=1\\\\n        context = 0 if autowater[trial_idx] == 1 else 1\\\\n\\\\n        # Outcome: incorrect=0, correct=1\\\\n        outcome = 1 if hit[trial_idx] else 0\\\\n\\\\n        # Tongue velocity (time-varying)\\\\n        if tongue_feat_idx is not None:\\\\n            tongue_vel = compute_velocity_from_traj(\\\\n                f, bottom_traj, trial_idx, tongue_feat_idx,\\\\n                n_timebins, gocue[trial_idx], vidshift, time_axis\\\\n            )\\\\n        else:\\\\n            tongue_vel = np.full(n_timebins, np.nan)\\\\n\\\\n        # Paw velocity (time-varying)\\\\n        if paw_feat_idx is not None:\\\\n            paw_vel = compute_velocity_from_traj(\\\\n                f, bottom_traj, trial_idx, paw_feat_idx,\\\\n                n_timebins, gocue[trial_idx], vidshift, time_axis\\\\n            )\\\\n        else:\\\\n            paw_vel = np.full(n_timebins, np.nan)\\\\n\\\\n        # Motion energy (time-varying)\\\\n        if me_data is not None:\\\\n            # Get frame times for this trial\\\\n            ft_ref = bottom_traj['frameTimes'][trial_idx, 0]\\\\n            frame_times = np.array(f[ft_ref]).flatten()\\\\n            me_trial = me_data[trial_idx]\\\\n            me_interp = interpolate_me_to_time_axis(\\\\n                me_trial, frame_times, vidshift, gocue[trial_idx], time_axis\\\\n            )\\\\n        else:\\\\n            me_interp = np.full(n_timebins, np.nan)\\\\n\\\\n        neural_trials.append(neural)\\\\n        input_trials.append(input_data)\\\\n\\\\n        # Store raw continuous values; discretization happens per-session after all trials\\\\n        output_trials.append({\\\\n            'lick_dir': lick_dir,\\\\n            'context': context,\\\\n            'outcome': outcome,\\\\n            'tongue_vel': tongue_vel,\\\\n            'paw_vel': paw_vel,\\\\n            'motion_energy': me_interp,\\\\n        })\\\\n        trial_indices_used.append(trial_idx)\\\\n\\\\n    f.close()\\\\n\\\\n    if len(neural_trials) < 2:\\\\n        print(f'  WARNING: Only {len(neural_trials)} valid trials, need at least 2, skipping')\\\\n        return None\\\\n\\\\n    # === Discretize continuous outputs per session ===\\\\n    # Collect all tongue_vel, paw_vel, motion_energy across trials for percentile\\\\n    all_tongue = np.concatenate([t['tongue_vel'] for t in output_trials])\\\\n    all_paw = np.concatenate([t['paw_vel'] for t in output_trials])\\\\n    all_me = np.concatenate([t['motion_energy'] for t in output_trials])\\\\n\\\\n    # Remove NaNs for percentile computation\\\\n    tongue_thresh = np.nanpercentile(all_tongue, 50) if not np.all(np.isnan(all_tongue)) else 0\\\\n    paw_thresh = np.nanpercentile(all_paw, 50) if not np.all(np.isnan(all_paw)) else 0\\\\n    me_thresh_50 = np.nanpercentile(all_me, 50) if not np.all(np.isnan(all_me)) else 0\\\\n\\\\n    # Build final output arrays\\\\n    final_output_trials = []\\\\n    for t in output_trials:\\\\n        tongue_disc = np.where(np.isnan(t['tongue_vel']), 0,\\\\n                              np.where(t['tongue_vel'] >= tongue_thresh, 1, 0)).astype(np.int64)\\\\n        paw_disc = np.where(np.isnan(t['paw_vel']), 0,\\\\n                           np.where(t['paw_vel'] >= paw_thresh, 1, 0)).astype(np.int64)\\\\n        me_disc = np.where(np.isnan(t['motion_energy']), 0,\\\\n                          np.where(t['motion_energy'] >= me_thresh_50, 1, 0)).astype(np.int64)\\\\n\\\\n        # Output array: (6, n_timebins) for time-varying, or (6,) for per-trial\\\\n        # lick_dir, context, outcome are per-trial (scalar)\\\\n        # tongue_vel, paw_vel, motion_energy are time-varying\\\\n        out = np.zeros((6, n_timebins), dtype=np.int64)\\\\n        out[0, :] = t['lick_dir']\\\\n        out[1, :] = t['context']\\\\n        out[2, :] = t['outcome']\\\\n        out[3, :] = tongue_disc\\\\n        out[4, :] = paw_disc\\\\n        out[5, :] = me_disc\\\\n\\\\n        final_output_trials.append(out)\\\\n\\\\n    return {\\\\n        'neural': neural_trials,\\\\n        'input': input_trials,\\\\n        'output': final_output_trials,\\\\n        'n_units': n_units_final,\\\\n        'anm': anm,\\\\n        'date': date,\\\\n        'n_trials': len(neural_trials),\\\\n        'n_valid_total': len(valid_idx),\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef main(output_file='converted_data.pkl', sample_file='sample_data.pkl'):\\\\n    # Time bin edges and centers\\\\n    time_edges = np.arange(TMIN, TMAX + DT, DT)\\\\n    time_axis = time_edges[:-1] + DT / 2\\\\n    n_timebins = len(time_axis)\\\\n\\\\n    print(f'Time axis: {n_timebins} bins, {TMIN} to {TMAX} s, dt={DT*1000:.0f} ms')\\\\n\\\\n    # Check which sessions actually exist\\\\n    available_sessions = []\\\\n    for anm, date, probes, data_dir in EPHYS_SESSIONS:\\\\n        fn = f'data_structure_{anm}_{date}.mat'\\\\n        fpath = os.path.join(DATA_ROOT, data_dir, fn)\\\\n        if os.path.exists(fpath):\\\\n            available_sessions.append((anm, date, probes, data_dir))\\\\n        else:\\\\n            print(f'  Skipping {anm}_{date}: file not found')\\\\n\\\\n    print(f'\\\\\\\\nFound {len(available_sessions)} session files')\\\\n\\\\n    # Process all sessions\\\\n    all_sessions = []\\\\n    subjects_set = []\\\\n\\\\n    for anm, date, probes, data_dir in available_sessions:\\\\n        result = process_session(anm, date, probes, data_dir, time_edges, time_axis)\\\\n        if result is not None:\\\\n            all_sessions.append(result)\\\\n            if anm not in subjects_set:\\\\n                subjects_set.append(anm)\\\\n\\\\n    print(f'\\\\\\\\nProcessed {len(all_sessions)} sessions from {len(subjects_set)} subjects')\\\\n\\\\n    # === Build final data structure ===\\\\n    subjects = subjects_set\\\\n    subject_idx = np.array([subjects.index(s['anm']) for s in all_sessions])\\\\n\\\\n    # Brain regions: all ALM\\\\n    brain_regions = ['ALM']\\\\n    brain_region_idx = [np.zeros(s['n_units'], dtype=np.int64) for s in all_sessions]\\\\n\\\\n    # Assemble lists\\\\n    neural = [s['neural'] for s in all_sessions]\\\\n    inputs = [s['input'] for s in all_sessions]\\\\n    outputs = [s['output'] for s in all_sessions]\\\\n\\\\n    data = {\\\\n        'neural': neural,\\\\n        'input': inputs,\\\\n        'output': outputs,\\\\n        'subjects': subjects,\\\\n        'subject_idx': subject_idx,\\\\n        'brain_regions': brain_regions,\\\\n        'brain_region_idx': brain_region_idx,\\\\n        'input_names': ['time_from_go_cue'],\\\\n        'output_names': ['lick_direction', 'behavioral_context', 'outcome',\\\\n                        'tongue_velocity', 'paw_velocity', 'motion_energy'],\\\\n        'output_values': [\\\\n            ['left', 'right'],        # lick_direction\\\\n            ['WC', 'DR'],             # behavioral_context\\\\n            ['incorrect', 'correct'], # outcome\\\\n            ['< 50th pctl', '>= 50th pctl'],  # tongue_velocity\\\\n            ['< 50th pctl', '>= 50th pctl'],  # paw_velocity\\\\n            ['< 50th pctl', '>= 50th pctl'],  # motion_energy\\\\n        ],\\\\n        'metadata': {\\\\n            'task_description': 'Two-context directional licking task: delayed-response (DR) and water-cued (WC) paradigms with electrophysiology in ALM',\\\\n            'time_bin_size': DT * 1000,  # in ms\\\\n            'temporal_alignment_event': 'Go cue onset',\\\\n            'off_start': TMIN,  # -2.5s before go cue\\\\n            'off_end': TMAX,    # 2.5s after go cue\\\\n            'smoothing': f'Causal Gaussian, window={SMOOTH_WINDOW} bins',\\\\n            'boundary_condition': BC_TYPE,\\\\n            'low_fr_threshold_hz': LOW_FR_THRESH,\\\\n            'n_sessions': len(all_sessions),\\\\n            'n_subjects': len(subjects),\\\\n            'session_info': [\\\\n                {\\\\n                    'animal': s['anm'],\\\\n                    'date': s['date'],\\\\n                    'n_units': s['n_units'],\\\\n                    'n_trials': s['n_trials'],\\\\n                }\\\\n                for s in all_sessions\\\\n            ],\\\\n        },\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    # Print summary statistics\\\\n    total_units = sum(s['n_units'] for s in all_sessions)\\\\n    total_trials = sum(s['n_trials'] for s in all_sessions)\\\\n    print(f'\\\\\\\\n=== Summary ===')\\\\n    print(f'Sessions: {len(all_sessions)}')\\\\n    print(f'Subjects: {len(subjects)} ({\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\".join(subjects)})')\\\\n    print(f'Total units: {total_units}')\\\\n    print(f'Total trials: {total_trials}')\\\\n    print(f'Time bins per trial: {n_timebins}')\\\\n\\\\n    # Per-session stats\\\\n    for i, s in enumerate(all_sessions):\\\\n        print(f'  Session {i}: {s[\\\\\\\"anm\\\\\\\"]}_{s[\\\\\\\"date\\\\\\\"]}, np.concatenate([np.zeros((N, x.shape[1])), x], axis=0)\\n        trim = N\\n    else:\\n        x_filt = x.copy()\\n        trim = 0\\n    kern = windows.gaussian(N, std=(N-1)/(2*2.5))\\n    kern[:N//2] = 0\\n    kern = kern / kern.sum()\\n    out = np.zeros_like(x_filt)\\n    for j in range(x_filt.shape[1]):\\n        out[:, j] = np.convolve(x_filt[:, j], kern, mode='same')\\n    out = 'RandomizedDelay_Ephys_Behavior'),\\n]\\n\\nDATA_ROOT = 'data'\\n\\n\\n# ============================================================\\n# Smoothing (matches mySmooth.m)\\n# ============================================================\\ndef causal_gaussian_smooth(x, N, bctype='reflect'):\\n    if N <= 1:\\n        return x\\n    was_1d = (x.ndim == 1)\\n    if was_1d:\\n        x = x[:, None]\\n    if bctype == 'reflect':\\n        x_filt = np.concatenate([x[:N, :], x], axis=0)\\n        trim = N\\n    elif bctype == 'zeropad':\\n        x_filt = np.concatenate([np.zeros((N, x.shape[1])), x], axis=0)\\n        trim = N\\n    else:\\n        x_filt = x.copy()\\n        trim = 0\\n    kern = windows.gaussian(N, std=(N-1)/(2*2.5))\\n    kern[:N//2] = 0\\n    kern = kern / kern.sum()\\n    out = np.zeros_like(x_filt)\\n    for j in range(x_filt.shape[1]):\\n        out[:, j] = np.convolve(x_filt[:, j], kern, mode='same')\\n    out = out[trim:, :]\\n    if was_1d:\\n        out = out[:, 0]\\n    return out\\n\\n\\n# ============================================================\\n# Unified data loader (handles both v7.3 HDF5 and v5 MAT)\\n# ============================================================\\nclass SessionData:\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Unified interface for loading session data from .mat files.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    def __init__(self, fpath):\\n        self.fpath = fpath\\n        self.is_h5 = self._check_h5(fpath)\\n        if self.is_h5:\\n            self.f = h5py.File(fpath, 'r')\\n            self.obj = _check_h5(self, fpath):\\n        with open(fpath, 'rb') as ff:\\n            header = ff.read(30).decode('ascii', errors='replace')\\n        return '7.3' in header\\n\\n    def close(self):\\n        if self.f is not None:\\n            self.f.close()\\n\\n    # --- Trial info ---\\n    def get_ntrials(self):\\n        if self.is_h5:\\n            return from bp (hit, miss, no, R, L, early, autowater).\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        if self.is_h5:\\n            return np.array(self.obj['bp'][field]).flatten()\\n        return np.array(getattr(self.obj_v5.bp, np.array(getattr(self.obj_v5.bp.ev, event)).flatten()\\n\\n    # --- Cluster data ---\\n    def get_clusters(self, probe_nums):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Get list of (quality, trial_array, trialtm_array) for each cluster.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        clusters = []\\n        if self.is_h5:\\n            clu_ref = self.obj['clu']\\n            for pnum in probe_nums:\\n                pidx = pnum - 1\\n                try:\\n                    ref = clu_ref[pidx, 0]\\n                    clu_group = self.f[ref]\\n                    if not isinstance(clu_group, h5py.Group):\\n                        continue\\n                except:\\n                    continue\\n                quality_refs = clu_group['quality']\\n                n_clu = quality_refs.shape[0]\\n                for i in range(n_clu):\\n                    q_ref = quality_refs[i, 0]\\n                    val = self.f[q_ref]\\n                    q = ''.join(chr(int(c)) for c in np.array(val).flatten()).strip().lower()\\n\\n                    t_ref = clu_group['trial'][i, 0]\\n                    trial = np.array(self.f[t_ref]).flatten()\\n\\n                    tt_ref = clu_group['trialtm'][i, 0]\\n                    trialtm = np.array(self.f[tt_ref]).flatten()\\n\\n                    clusters.append((q, trial, trialtm))\\n        else:\\n            clu = self.obj_v5.clu\\n            # v5 format: clu is flat array of cluster structs (single probe)\\n            # or sometimes cell array {probe1_clusters, probe2_clusters}\\n            if isinstance(clu, np.ndarray) and len(clu) > 0:\\n                first = clu[0]\\n                if hasattr(first, 'quality'):\\n                    # Flat array of cluster structs (single probe)\\n                    for c in clu:\\n                        q = str(c.quality).strip().lower()\\n                        trial = np.array(c.trial).flatten()\\n                        trialtm = np.array(c.trialtm).flatten()\\n                        clusters.append((q, trial, trialtm))\\n                elif isinstance(first, np.ndarray):\\n                    # Cell array by probe\\n                    for pnum in probe_nums:\\n                        pidx = pnum - 1\\n                        if pidx < len(clu):\\n                            probe_clu = clu[pidx]\\n                            if isinstance(probe_clu, np.ndarray):\\n                                for c in probe_clu:\\n                                    q = str(c.quality).strip().lower()\\n                                    trial = np.array(c.trial).flatten()\\n                                    trialtm = np.array(c.trialtm).flatten()\\n                                    clusters.append((q, trial, trialtm))\\n        return clusters\\n\\n    # --- Video offset ---\\n    def get_video_offset(self):\\n        if self.is_h5:\\n            bitStart = np.array(self.obj['bp']['ev']['bitStart']).flatten()\\n            sglx_bitstart = np.array(self.obj['sglx']['bitcode']['bitstart']).flatten()\\n            sglx_fs = float(np.array(self.obj['sglx']['fs']).flatten()[0])\\n        else:\\n            bitStart = np.array(self.obj_v5.bp.ev.bitStart).flatten()\\n            sglx_bitstart = np.array(self.obj_v5.sglx.bitcode.bitstart).flatten()\\n            sglx_fs = float(np.array(self.obj_v5.sglx.fs).flatten()[0])\\n\\n        bs_mode = float(stats.mode(bitStart, keepdims=False).mode)\\n        sglx_mode = float(stats.mode(sglx_bitstart, keepdims=False).mode)\\n        return sglx_mode / sglx_fs - bs_mode\\n\\n    # --- Trajectory data ---\\n    def get_traj_feature_names(self, view):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Get feature names for a camera view (0=side, 1=bottom).\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        if self.is_h5:\\n            traj_ref = self.obj['traj'][view, 0]\\n            traj_g = self.f[traj_ref]\\n            feat_ref = traj_g['featNames'][0, 0]\\n            feat_data = self.f[feat_ref]\\n            names = []\\n            if feat_data.shape[0] == 1:\\n                for i in range(feat_data.shape[1]):\\n                    ref = feat_data[0, i]\\n                    val = self.f[ref]\\n                    names.append(''.join(chr(int(c)) for c in np.array(val).flatten()))\\n            else:\\n                for i in and feature.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        if self.is_h5:\\n            traj_ref = self.obj['traj'][view, 0]\\n            traj_g = self.f[traj_ref]\\n\\n            ft_ref = traj_g['frameTimes'][trial_idx, n_frames)\\n            x = ts[feat_idx, 0, :]\\n            y = ts[feat_idx, 1, :]\\n        else:\\n            traj_view = self.obj_v5.traj[view]\\n            trial_data = traj_view[trial_idx]\\n            frame_times = np.array(trial_data.frameTimes).flatten()\\n            ts = np.array(trial_data.ts)\\n            # v5: (n_frames, 3, n_feats)\\n            x = ts[:, 0, feat_idx]\\n            y = ts[:, 1, feat_idx]\\n        return frame_times, x, y\\n\\n    def get_trial_frame_times(self, view, trial_idx):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Get frame times for a trial.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        if np.array(self.f[ft_ref]).flatten()\\n        else:\\n            return np.array(self.obj_v5.traj[view][trial_idx].frameTimes).flatten()\\n\\n\\ndef load_motion_energy(data_dir, anm, date):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Load motion energy data from .mat file.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    me_fn = f'motionEnergy_{anm}_{date}.mat'\\n    me_path = os.path.join(DATA_ROOT, data_dir, me_fn)\\n\\n    if not os.path.exists(me_path):\\n        return None, None\\n\\n    try:\\n        me_mat = sio.loadmat(me_path, squeeze_me=False, struct_as_record=True)\\n        me = me_mat['me'][0, 0]\\n        thresh = float(me['moveThresh'].flatten()[0])\\n        data_field = me['data']\\n        if data_field.dtype.names is not None and 'data' in data_field.dtype.names:\\n            data_field = data_field[0, 0]['data']\\n        data_arr = data_field.flatten()\\n        me_list = [data_arr[i].flatten().astype(float) for i in range(len(data_arr))]\\n        return me_list, thresh\\n    except Exception as e:\\n        try:\\n            me_f = h5py.File(me_path, 'r')\\n            me = me_f['me']\\n            thresh = float(np.array(me['moveThresh']).flatten()[0])\\n            data_refs = me['data']\\n            me_list = []\\n            for i in range(data_refs.shape[0]):\\n                ref = data_refs[i, 0]\\n                d = np.array(me_f[ref]).flatten()\\n                me_list.append(d)\\n            me_f.close()\\n            return me_list, thresh\\n        except Exception as e2:\\n            print(f'  WARNING: Cannot load motion energy: {e2}')\\n            return None, None\\n\\n\\n# ============================================================\\n# Main processing\\n# ============================================================\\ndef process_session(anm, date, probe_nums, data_dir, time_edges, time_axis):\\n    fn = f'data_structure_{anm}_{date}.mat'\\n    fpath = os.path.join(DATA_ROOT, data_dir, fn)\\n\\n    if not os.path.exists(fpath):\\n        print(f'  WARNING: File not found: {fpath}')\\n        return None\\n\\n    print(f'  Loading {anm}_{date} (probes {probe_nums})...')\\n\\n    sd = SessionData(fpath)\\n    ntrials = sd.get_ntrials()\\n    n_timebins = len(time_axis)\\n\\n    # Trial info\\n    hit = sd.get_trial_array('hit').astype(bool)\\n    miss = sd.get_trial_array('miss').astype(bool)\\n    R = sd.get_trial_array('R').astype(bool)\\n    L = sd.get_trial_array('L').astype(bool)\\n    autowater = sd.get_trial_array('autowater')\\n    early = sd.get_trial_array('early').astype(bool)\\n    stim_enable = sd.get_stim_enable().astype(bool)\\n    gocue = sd.get_event_times('goCue')\\n\\n    # Trial selection: hit or miss, no stim, no early\\n    valid_trials = (hit | miss) & ~stim_enable & ~early\\n    valid_idx = np.where(valid_trials)[0]\\n\\n    if len(valid_idx) < 5:\\n        print(f'  WARNING: Too few valid trials ({len(valid_idx)}), skipping')\\n        sd.close()\\n        return None\\n\\n    # Get clusters\\n    clusters = sd.get_clusters(probe_nums)\\n    # Filter by quality\\n    filtered_clusters = [(q, t, tt) for q, t, tt in clusters if q not in EXCLUDE_QUALITIES]\\n\\n    if len(filtered_clusters) == 0:\\n        print(f'  WARNING: No valid clusters, skipping')\\n        sd.close()\\n        return None\\n\\n    n_units = len(filtered_clusters)\\n\\n    # Bin spikes aligned to go cue\\n    trialdat = np.zeros((n_units, n_timebins, ntrials))\\n    for i, (q, trial_nums, spike_times) in enumerate(filtered_clusters):\\n        for j in range(ntrials):\\n            trial_mask = (trial_nums == (j + 1))\\n            if not np.any(trial_mask):\\n                continue\\n            aligned_times = spike_times[trial_mask] - gocue[j]\\n            counts, _ = np.histogram(aligned_times, bins=time_edges)\\n            fr = counts / DT\\n            trialdat[i, :, j] = causal_gaussian_smooth(fr, SMOOTH_WINDOW, BC_TYPE)\\n\\n    # Remove low FR units\\n    mean_frs = np.mean(np.mean(trialdat[:, :, valid_idx], axis=2), axis=1)\\n    keep_units = mean_frs > LOW_FR_THRESH\\n\\n    if keep_units.sum() < 10:\\n        print(f'  WARNING: Only {keep_units.sum()} units with FR>{LOW_FR_THRESH} Hz, skipping')\\n        sd.close()\\n        return None\\n\\n    trialdat = trialdat[keep_units, :, :]\\n    n_units_final = trialdat.shape[0]\\n    print(f'  {n_units_final} units after filtering (from {n_units} total)')\\n\\n    # Video offset\\n    vidshift = sd.get_video_offset()\\n\\n    # Get feature indices for tongue and paw (bottom cam)\\n    try:\\n        bottom_feats = sd.get_traj_feature_names(1)\\n        tongue_feat_idx = None\\n        paw_feat_idx = None\\n        for idx, name in enumerate(bottom_feats):\\n            if name == 'top_tongue' and tongue_feat_idx is None:\\n                tongue_feat_idx = idx\\n            if name == 'bottom_paw' and paw_feat_idx is None:\\n                paw_feat_idx = idx\\n        if tongue_feat_idx is None:\\n            for idx, name in enumerate(bottom_feats):\\n                if 'tongue' in name.lower():\\n                    tongue_feat_idx = idx\\n                    break\\n        if paw_feat_idx is None:\\n            for idx, name in enumerate(bottom_feats):\\n                if 'paw' in name.lower():\\n                    paw_feat_idx = idx\\n                    break\\n    except:\\n        tongue_feat_idx = None\\n        paw_feat_idx = None\\n\\n    # Load motion energy\\n    me_data, me_thresh = load_motion_energy(data_dir, anm, date)\\n\\n    # Process each valid trial\\n    neural_trials = []\\n    input_trials = []\\n    raw_outputs = []\\n\\n    for trial_idx in valid_idx:\\n        neural = trialdat[:, :, trial_idx]\\n        input_data = time_axis.reshape(1, -1).copy()\\n\\n        lick_dir = 1 if R[trial_idx] else 0\\n        context = 0 if autowater[trial_idx] == 1 else 1\\n        outcome = 1 if hit[trial_idx] else 0\\n\\n        # Tongue velocity\\n        tongue_vel = np.full(n_timebins, np.nan)\\n        if tongue_feat_idx is not None:\\n            try:\\n                ft, x, y = sd.get_trial_traj(1, trial_idx, tongue_feat_idx)\\n                dt_vid = 1.0 / VIDEO_FPS\\n                vel = np.sqrt(np.diff(x)**2 + np.diff(y)**2) / dt_vid\\n                vel_t = ft[:-1] + dt_vid / 2\\n                vel_t_aligned = vel_t - vidshift - gocue[trial_idx]\\n                tongue_vel = np.interp(time_axis, vel_t_aligned, vel, left=np.nan, right=np.nan)\\n            except:\\n                pass\\n\\n        # Paw velocity\\n        paw_vel = np.full(n_timebins, np.nan)\\n        if paw_feat_idx is not None:\\n            try:\\n                ft, x, y = sd.get_trial_traj(1, trial_idx, paw_feat_idx)\\n                dt_vid = 1.0 / VIDEO_FPS\\n                vel = np.sqrt(np.diff(x)**2 + np.diff(y)**2) / dt_vid\\n                vel_t = ft[:-1] + dt_vid / 2\\n                vel_t_aligned = vel_t - vidshift - gocue[trial_idx]\\n                paw_vel = np.interp(time_axis, vel_t_aligned, vel, left=np.nan, right=np.nan)\\n            except:\\n                pass\\n\\n        # Motion energy\\n        me_interp = np.full(n_timebins, np.nan)\\n        if me_data is not me_interp = np.interp(time_axis, ft_aligned, me_data[trial_idx], left=np.nan, right=np.nan)\\n            except:\\n                pass\\n\\n        neural_trials.append(neural)\\n        input_trials.append(input_data)\\n        raw_outputs.append({\\n            'lick_dir': lick_dir,\\n            'context': context,\\n            'outcome': outcome,\\n            'tongue_vel': {len(neural_trials)} valid trials, skipping')\\n        return None\\n\\n    # Discretize continuous outputs per session (50th percentile threshold)\\n    all_tongue = np.concatenate([t['tongue_vel'] for t in raw_outputs])\\n    all_paw = np.concatenate([t['paw_vel'] for t in raw_outputs])\\n    all_me = np.concatenate([t['motion_energy'] for t in raw_outputs])\\n\\n    tongue_thresh = np.nanpercentile(all_tongue, 50) if not np.all(np.isnan(all_tongue)) else 0\\n    paw_thresh = np.nanpercentile(all_paw, 50) if not np.all(np.isnan(all_paw)) else 0\\n    me_thresh_50 = np.nanpercentile(all_me, 50) if not np.all(np.isnan(all_me)) else 0\\n\\n    final_output_trials = []\\n    for t in raw_outputs:\\n        tongue_disc = np.where(np.isnan(t['tongue_vel']), 0,\\n                              np.where(t['tongue_vel'] >= tongue_thresh, 1, 0)).astype(np.int64)\\n        paw_disc = np.where(np.isnan(t['paw_vel']), 0,\\n                           np.where(t['paw_vel'] >= paw_thresh, 1, 0)).astype(np.int64)\\n        me_disc = np.where(np.isnan(t['motion_energy']), 0,\\n                          np.where(t['motion_energy'] >= me_thresh_50, 1, 0)).astype(np.int64)\\n\\n        out = np.zeros((6, n_timebins), dtype=np.int64)\\n        out[0, :] = t['lick_dir']\\n        out[1, :] = t['context']\\n        out[2, :] = t['outcome']\\n        out[3, :] = tongue_disc\\n        out[4, :] = paw_disc\\n        out[5, :] = me_disc\\n        final_output_trials.append(out)\\n\\n    return {\\n        'neural': neural_trials,\\n        'input': main(output_file='converted_data.pkl', sample_file='sample_data.pkl'):\\n    time_edges = np.arange(TMIN, TMAX + DT, DT)\\n    time_axis = time_edges[:-1] + DT / 2\\n    n_timebins = len(time_axis)\\n\\n    print(f'Time axis: {n_timebins} bins, {TMIN} to {TMAX} s, dt={DT*1000:.0f} ms')\\n\\n    available = []\\n    for anm, date, probes, data_dir in EPHYS_SESSIONS:\\n        fn = f'data_structure_{anm}_{date}.mat'\\n        fpath = os.path.join(DATA_ROOT, data_dir, fn)\\n        if os.path.exists(fpath):\\n            available.append((anm, date, probes, data_dir))\\n        else:\\n            print(f'  Skipping {anm}_{date}: file not found')\\n\\n    print(f'\\\\nFound {len(available)} session files')\\n\\n    all_sessions = []\\n    subjects_set = []\\n\\n    for anm, all_sessions.append(result)\\n            if anm not in subjects_set:\\n                subjects_set.append(anm)\\n\\n    print(f'\\\\nProcessed {len(all_sessions)} sessions from {len(subjects_set)} subjects')\\n\\n    subjects = subjects_set\\n    subject_idx = np.array([subjects.index(s['anm']) for s in all_sessions])\\n\\n    brain_regions = ['ALM']\\n    brain_region_idx = [np.zeros(s['n_units'], dtype=np.int64) for s in all_sessions]\\n\\n    neural = [s['neural'] for s in all_sessions]\\n    inputs = [s['input'] for s in all_sessions]\\n    outputs = [s['output'] for s in all_sessions]\\n\\n    data = {\\n        'neural': neural,\\n        'input': inputs,\\n        'output': outputs,\\n        'subjects': subjects,\\n        'subject_idx': subject_idx,\\n        'brain_regions': brain_regions,\\n        'brain_region_idx': brain_region_idx,\\n        'input_names': ['time_from_go_cue'],\\n        'output_names': ['lick_direction', 'behavioral_context', 'outcome',\\n                        'tongue_velocity', 'paw_velocity', 'motion_energy'],\\n        'output_values': [\\n            ['left', 'right'],\\n            ['WC', 'DR'],\\n ============================================================\\\\ndef causal_gaussian_smooth(x, N, bctype='reflect'):\\\\n    if N <= 1:\\\\n        return x\\\\n    was_1d = (x.ndim == 1)\\\\n    if was_1d:\\\\n        x = x[:, None]\\\\n    if bctype == 'reflect':\\\\n        x_filt = np.concatenate([x[:N, :], x], axis=0)\\\\n        trim = N\\\\n    elif bctype == 'zeropad':\\\\n        x_filt = np.concatenate([np.zeros((N, x.shape[1])), x], axis=0)\\\\n        trim = N\\\\n    else:\\\\n        x_filt = x.copy()\\\\n        trim = 0\\\\n    kern = windows.gaussian(N, std=(N-1)/(2*2.5))\\\\n    kern[:N//2] = 0\\\\n    kern = kern / kern.sum()\\\\n    out = np.zeros_like(x_filt)\\\\n    for j in range(x_filt.shape[1]):\\\\n        out[:, j] = np.convolve(x_filt[:, j], kern, mode='same')\\\\n    out = out[trim:, :]\\\\n    if was_1d:\\\\n        out = out[:, 0]\\\\n    return out\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n# ============================================================\\\\n# Unified data loader (handles both v7.3 HDF5 and v5 MAT)\\\\n# ============================================================\\\\nclass SessionData:\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Unified interface for    return np.array(getattr(self.obj_v5.bp.ev, event)).flatten()\\\\n\\\\n    # --- Cluster data ---\\\\n    def get_clusters(self, probe_nums):\\\\n        \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Get list of             n_clu = quality_refs.shape[0]\\\\n                for i in range(n_clu):\\\\n                    q_ref = quality_refs[i, 0]\\\\n                    val = self.f[q_ref]\\\\n                    q = ''.join(chr(int(c)) for c in np.array(val).flatten()).strip().lower()\\\\n\\\\n                    t_ref = clu_group['trial'][i, 0]\\\\n                    trial = np.array(self.f[t_ref]).flatten()\\\\n\\\\n                    tt_ref = clu_group['trialtm'][i, 0]\\\\n                    trialtm = np.array(self.f[tt_ref]).flatten()\\\\n\\\\n                    clusters.append((q, trial, trialtm))\\\\n        else:\\\\n            clu = self.obj_v5.clu\\\\n            # v5 format: clu is flat array of cluster structs (single probe)\\\\n            # or            trial = np.array(c.trial).flatten()\\\\n                        trialtm = np.array(c.trialtm).flatten()\\\\n                        clusters.append((q, trial, trialtm))\\\\n                elif isinstance(first, np.ndarray):\\\\n                    # Cell array by probe\\\\n                    for pnum in probe_nums:\\\\n                        pidx = pnum - 1\\\\n                        if pidx < len(clu):\\\\n                            probe_clu = clu[pidx]\\\\n                            if isinstance(probe_clu, np.ndarray):\\\\n                                for c in probe_clu:\\\\n                                    q = str(c.quality).strip().lower()\\\\n                                    trial = np.array(c.trial).flatten()\\\\n                                    trialtm = np.array(c.trialtm).flatten()\\\\n                                    clusters.append((q, trial, trialtm))\\\\n        return clusters\\\\n\\\\n    # --- Video offset ---\\\\n    def get_video_offset(self):\\\\n        if self.is_h5:\\\\n            bitStart = np.array(self.obj['bp']['ev']['bitStart']).flatten()\\\\n            sglx_bitstart = np.array(self.obj['sglx']['bitcode']['bitstart']).flatten()\\\\n            sglx_fs = float(np.array(self.obj['sglx']['fs']).flatten()[0])\\\\n        else:\\\\n            bitStart = np.array(self.obj_v5.bp.ev.bitStart).flatten()\\\\n            sglx_bitstart = np.array(self.obj_v5.sglx.bitcode.bitstart).flatten()\\\\n            sglx_fs = keepdims=False).mode)\\\\n        return sglx_mode / sglx_fs - bs_mode\\\\n\\\\n    # --- Trajectory data ---\\\\n    def get_traj_feature_names(self, view):\\\\n        \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Get feature names for a camera view (0=side, 1=bottom).\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n        if self.is_h5:\\\\n            traj_ref = self.obj['traj'][view, 0]\\\\n            traj_g =      for i in range(feat_data.shape[1]):\\\\n                    ref = feat_data[0, i]\\\\n                    val = self.f[ref]\\\\n                    names.append(''.join(chr(int(c)) for c in feats = traj_view[0].featNames\\\\n            if isinstance(feats, str):\\\\n                return [feats]\\\\n            return list(feats)\\\\n\\\\n    def get_trial_traj(self, view, trial_idx, self.obj['traj'][view, 0]\\\\n            traj_g = self.f[traj_ref]\\\\n\\\\n            ft_ref = traj_g['frameTimes'][trial_idx, 0]\\\\n            frame_times = x = ts[feat_idx, 0, :]\\\\n            y = ts[feat_idx, 1, :]\\\\n        else:\\\\n            traj_view = self.obj_v5.traj[view]\\\\n            trial_data = traj_view[trial_idx]\\\\n            frame_times = np.array(trial_data.frameTimes).flatten()\\\\n            ts = np.array(trial_data.ts)\\\\n            # v5: (n_frames, 3, n_feats)\\\\n            x = ts[:, 0, feat_idx]\\\\n            y = ts[:, 1, feat_idx]\\\\n        return frame_times, x, y\\\\n\\\\n    def get_trial_frame_times(self, view, trial_idx):\\\\n        \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Get frame times for a traj_g['frameTimes'][trial_idx, 0]\\\\n            return np.array(self.f[ft_ref]).flatten()\\\\n        else:\\\\n            return np.array(self.obj_v5.traj[view][trial_idx].frameTimes).flatten()\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef load_motion_energy(data_dir, anm, date):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Load motion energy data from .mat file.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    me_fn = f'motionEnergy_{anm}_{date}.mat'\\\\n    me_path = os.path.join(DATA_ROOT, data_dir, me_fn)\\\\n\\\\n    if not os.path.exists(me_path):\\\\n        return None, None\\\\n\\\\n    try:\\\\n        me_mat = sio.loadmat(me_path, squeeze_me=False, struct_as_record=True)\\\\n        me = me_mat['me'][0, 0]\\\\n        thresh = float(me['moveThresh'].flatten()[0])\\\\n        data_field = me['data']\\\\n        if data_field.dtype.names is not None and 'data' in data_field.dtype.names:\\\\n            data_field = data_field[0, 0]['data']\\\\n        data_arr = data_field.flatten()\\\\n        me_list = [data_arr[i].flatten().astype(float) for i in range(len(data_arr))]\\\\n        return me_list, thresh\\\\n    except Exception as e:\\\\n        try:\\\\n            me_f = h5py.File(me_path, 'r')\\\\n            me = me_f['me']\\\\n            thresh = float(np.array(me['moveThresh']).flatten()[0])\\\\n            data_refs = me['data']\\\\n            me_list = []\\\\n            for i in range(data_refs.shape[0]):\\\\n                ref = data_refs[i, 0]\\\\n                d = np.array(me_f[ref]).flatten()\\\\n                me_list.append(d)\\\\n            me_f.close()\\\\n            return me_list, thresh\\\\n        except Exception as e2:\\\\n            print(f'  WARNING: Cannot load motion energy: {e2}')\\\\n            return None, None\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n# ============================================================\\\\n# Main processing\\\\n# ============================================================\\\\ndef process_session(anm, date, probe_nums, data_dir, time_edges, time_axis):\\\\n    fn = f'data_structure_{anm}_{date}.mat'\\\\n    fpath = os.path.join(DATA_ROOT, data_dir, fn)\\\\n\\\\n    if not os.path.exists(fpath):\\\\n        print(f'  WARNING: File not found: {fpath}')\\\\n        return None\\\\n\\\\n    print(f'  Loading {anm}_{date} (probes {probe_nums})...')\\\\n\\\\n    sd = SessionData(fpath)\\\\n    ntrials = sd.get_ntrials()\\\\n    n_timebins = len(time_axis)\\\\n\\\\n    # Trial info\\\\n    hit = sd.get_trial_array('hit').astype(bool)\\\\n    miss = sd.get_trial_array('miss').astype(bool)\\\\n    R = sd.get_trial_array('R').astype(bool)\\\\n    L = sd.get_trial_array('L').astype(bool)\\\\n    autowater = sd.get_trial_array('autowater')\\\\n    early = sd.get_trial_array('early').astype(bool)\\\\n    stim_enable = sd.get_stim_enable().astype(bool)\\\\n    gocue = sd.get_event_times('goCue')\\\\n\\\\n    # Trial selection: hit or miss, no stim, no early\\\\n    valid_trials = (hit | miss) & ~stim_enable & ~early\\\\n    valid_idx = np.where(valid_trials)[0]\\\\n\\\\n    if len(valid_idx) < 5:\\\\n        print(f'  WARNING: Too few valid trials ({len(valid_idx)}), skipping')\\\\n        sd.close()\\\\n        return None\\\\n\\\\n    # Get clusters\\\\n    clusters = sd.get_clusters(probe_nums)\\\\n    # Filter by quality\\\\n    filtered_clusters = [(q, t, tt) for q, t, tt in clusters if q not in EXCLUDE_QUALITIES]\\\\n\\\\n    if len(filtered_clusters) == 0:\\\\n        print(f'  WARNING: No valid clusters, skipping')\\\\n        sd.close()\\\\n        return None\\\\n\\\\n    n_units = len(filtered_clusters)\\\\n\\\\n    # Bin spikes aligned to go cue\\\\n    trialdat = np.zeros((n_units, n_timebins, ntrials))\\\\n    for i, (q, trial_nums, spike_times) in enumerate(filtered_clusters):\\\\n        for j in range(ntrials):\\\\n            trial_mask = (trial_nums == (j + 1))\\\\n            if not np.any(trial_mask):\\\\n                continue\\\\n            aligned_times = spike_times[trial_mask] - gocue[j]\\\\n            counts, _ = np.histogram(aligned_times, bins=time_edges)\\\\n            fr = counts / DT\\\\n            trialdat[i, :, j] = causal_gaussian_smooth(fr, SMOOTH_WINDOW, BC_TYPE)\\\\n\\\\n    # Remove low FR units\\\\n    mean_frs = np.mean(np.mean(trialdat[:, :, valid_idx], axis=2), axis=1)\\\\n    keep_units = mean_frs > LOW_FR_THRESH\\\\n\\\\n    if keep_units.sum() < 10:\\\\n        print(f'  WARNING: Only {keep_units.sum()} units with FR>{LOW_FR_THRESH} Hz, skipping')\\\\n        sd.close()\\\\n        return None\\\\n\\\\n    trialdat = trialdat[keep_units, :, :]\\\\n    n_units_final = trialdat.shape[0]\\\\n    print(f'  {n_units_final} units after filtering (from {n_units} total)')\\\\n\\\\n    # Video offset\\\\n    vidshift = sd.get_video_offset()\\\\n\\\\n    # Get feature indices for tongue and paw (bottom cam)\\\\n    try:\\\\n        bottom_feats = sd.get_traj_feature_names(1)\\\\n        tongue_feat_idx = None\\\\n        paw_feat_idx = None\\\\n        for idx, name in enumerate(bottom_feats):\\\\n            if name == 'top_tongue' and tongue_feat_idx is None:\\\\n                tongue_feat_idx = idx\\\\n            if name == 'bottom_paw' and paw_feat_idx is None:\\\\n                paw_feat_idx = idx\\\\n        if tongue_feat_idx is None:\\\\n            for idx, name in enumerate(bottom_feats):\\\\n                if 'tongue' in name.lower():\\\\n                    tongue_feat_idx = idx\\\\n                    break\\\\n        if paw_feat_idx is None:\\\\n            for idx, name in enumerate(bottom_feats):\\\\n                if 'paw' in name.lower():\\\\n                    paw_feat_idx = idx\\\\n                    break\\\\n    except:\\\\n        tongue_feat_idx = None\\\\n        paw_feat_idx = None\\\\n\\\\n    # Load motion energy\\\\n    me_data, me_thresh = load_motion_energy(data_dir, anm, date)\\\\n\\\\n    # Process each valid trial\\\\n    neural_trials = []\\\\n    input_trials = []\\\\n    raw_outputs = []\\\\n\\\\n    for trial_idx in valid_idx:\\\\n        neural = trialdat[:, :, trial_idx]\\\\n        input_data = time_axis.reshape(1, -1).copy()\\\\n\\\\n        lick_dir = 1 if R[trial_idx] else 0\\\\n        context = 0 if autowater[trial_idx] == 1 else 1\\\\n        outcome = 1 if hit[trial_idx] else 0\\\\n\\\\n        # Tongue velocity\\\\n        tongue_vel = np.full(n_timebins, np.nan)\\\\n        if tongue_feat_idx is not None:\\\\n            try:\\\\n                ft, x, y = sd.get_trial_traj(1, trial_idx, tongue_feat_idx)\\\\n                dt_vid = 1.0 / VIDEO_FPS\\\\n                vel = np.sqrt(np.diff(x)**2 + np.diff(y)**2) / dt_vid\\\\n                vel_t = ft[:-1] + dt_vid / 2\\\\n                vel_t_aligned = vel_t - vidshift - gocue[trial_idx]\\\\n                tongue_vel = np.interp(time_axis, vel_t_aligned, vel, left=np.nan, right=np.nan)\\\\n            except:\\\\n                pass\\\\n\\\\n        # Paw velocity\\\\n        paw_vel = np.full(n_timebins, np.nan)\\\\n        if paw_feat_idx is not None:\\\\n            try:\\\\n                ft, x, y = sd.get_trial_traj(1, trial_idx, paw_feat_idx)\\\\n                dt_vid = 1.0 / VIDEO_FPS\\\\n                vel = np.sqrt(np.diff(x)**2 + np.diff(y)**2) / dt_vid\\\\n                vel_t = ft[:-1] + dt_vid / 2\\\\n                vel_t_aligned = vel_t - vidshift - gocue[trial_idx]\\\\n                paw_vel = np.interp(time_axis, vel_t_aligned, vel, left=np.nan, np.interp(time_axis, ft_aligned, me_data[trial_idx], left=np.nan, right=np.nan)\\\\n            except:\\\\n                pass\\\\n\\\\n        neural_trials.append(neural)\\\\n        input_trials.append(input_data)\\\\n        raw_outputs.append({\\\\n            'lick_dir': lick_dir,\\\\n            'context': context,\\\\n            'outcome': outcome,\\\\n            'tongue_vel': tongue_vel,\\\\n            'paw_vel': paw_vel,\\\\n            'motion_energy': me_interp,\\\\n        })\\\\n\\\\n    sd.close()\\\\n\\\\n    if len(neural_trials) < 2:\\\\n        print(f'  WARNING: Only {len(neural_trials)} valid trials, skipping')\\\\n        return None\\\\n\\\\n    # Discretize continuous outputs per session (50th percentile threshold)\\\\n    all_tongue = np.concatenate([t['tongue_vel'] for t in raw_outputs])\\\\n    all_paw = np.concatenate([t['paw_vel'] for t in raw_outputs])\\\\n    all_me = np.concatenate([t['motion_energy'] for t in raw_outputs])\\\\n\\\\n    tongue_thresh = np.nanpercentile(all_tongue, 50) if not np.all(np.isnan(all_tongue)) else 0\\\\n    paw_thresh = np.nanpercentile(all_paw, 50) if not np.all(np.isnan(all_paw)) else 0\\\\n    me_thresh_50 = np.nanpercentile(all_me, 50) if not np.all(np.isnan(all_me)) else 0\\\\n\\\\n    final_output_trials = []\\\\n    for t in raw_outputs:\\\\n        tongue_disc = np.where(np.isnan(t['tongue_vel']), 0,\\\\n                              np.where(t['tongue_vel'] >= tongue_thresh, 1, 0)).astype(np.int64)\\\\n        paw_disc = np.where(np.isnan(t['paw_vel']), 0,\\\\n                           np.where(t['paw_vel'] >= paw_thresh, 1, 0)).astype(np.int64)\\\\n        me_disc = np.where(np.isnan(t['motion_energy']), 0,\\\\n                          np.where(t['motion_energy'] >= me_thresh_50, 1, 0)).astype(np.int64)\\\\n\\\\n        out = np.zeros((6, n_timebins), dtype=np.int64)\\\\n        out[0, :] = t['lick_dir']\\\\n        out[1, :] = t['context']\\\\n        out[2, :] = t['outcome']\\\\n        out[3, :] = tongue_disc\\\\n        out[4, :] = paw_disc\\\\n        out[5, :] = me_disc\\\\n        final_output_trials.append(out)\\\\n\\\\n    return {\\\\n        'neural': neural_trials,\\\\n        'input': input_trials,\\\\n        'output': final_output_trials,\\\\n        'n_units': n_units_final,\\\\n        'anm': anm,\\\\n        'date': date,\\\\n        'n_trials': len(neural_trials),\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef main(output_file='converted_data.pkl', sample_file='sample_data.pkl'):\\\\n    time_edges = np.arange(TMIN, TMAX + DT, DT)\\\\n    time_axis = time_edges[:-1] + DT / 2\\\\n    n_timebins = len(time_axis)\\\\n\\\\n    print(f'Time axis: {n_timebins} bins, {TMIN} to {TMAX} s, dt={DT*1000:.0f} ms')\\\\n\\\\n    available = []\\\\n    for anm, date, probes, data_dir in EPHYS_SESSIONS:\\\\n        fn = f'data_structure_{anm}_{date}.mat'\\\\n        fpath = os.path.join(DATA_ROOT, data_dir, fn)\\\\n        if os.path.exists(fpath):\\\\n            available.append((anm, date, probes, data_dir))\\\\n        else:\\\\n            print(f'  Skipping {anm}_{date}: file not found')\\\\n\\\\n    print(f'\\\\\\\\nFound {len(available)} session files')\\\\n\\\\n    all_sessions = []\\\\n    subjects_set =  all_sessions.append(result)\\\\n            if anm not in subjects_set:\\\\n                subjects_set.append(anm)\\\\n\\\\n    print(f'\\\\\\\\nProcessed {len(all_sessions)} sessions from {len(subjects_set)} subjects')\\\\n\\\\n    subjects = subjects_set\\\\n    subject_idx = np.array([subjects.index(s['anm']) for s in all_sessions])\\\\n\\\\n    brain_regions = ['ALM']\\\\n    brain_region_idx = [np.zeros(s['n_units'], dtype=np.int64) for s in all_sessions]\\\\n\\\\n    neural = [s['neural'] for s in all_sessions]\\\\n    inputs = [s['input'] for s in all_sessions]\\\\n    outputs = [s['output'] for s in all_sessions]\\\\n\\\\n    data = {\\\\n        'neural': neural,\\\\n        'input': inputs,\\\\n        'output': outputs,\\\\n        'subjects': subjects,\\\\n        'subject_idx': subject_idx,\\\\n        'brain_regions': brain_regions,\\\\n        'brain_region_idx': brain_region_idx,\\\\n        'input_names': ['time_from_go_cue'],\\\\n        'output_names': ['lick_direction', 'behavioral_context', 'outcome',\\\\n                        'tongue_velocity', 'paw_velocity', 'motion_energy'],\\\\n        'output_values': [\\\\n            ['left', 'right'],\\\\n            ['WC', 'DR'],\\\\n            ['incorrect', 'correct'],\\\\n            ['< 50th pctl', '>= 50th pctl'],\\\\n            ['< 50th pctl', '>= 50th pctl'],\\\\n ('JEB23', '2023-10-20', [1], 'RandomizedDelay_Ephys_Behavior'),\\n]\\n\\nDATA_ROOT = 'data'\\n\\n\\n# ============================================================\\n# Helper functions\\n# ============================================================\\n\\ndef causal_gaussian_smooth(x, N, bctype='reflect'):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    Causal Gaussian smoothing matching mySmooth.m.\\n    x: (n_timepoints,) or (n_timepoints, n_cols)\\n    N: window size\\n    bctype: 'reflect', 'zeropad', or 'none'\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if N <= 1:\\n        return x\\n\\n    was_1d = (x.ndim == 1)\\n    if was_1d:\\n        x = x[:, None]\\n\\n    # Boundary condition handling\\n    if bctype == 'reflect':\\n        x_filt = np.concatenate([x[:N, :], x], axis=0)\\n        trim = N\\n    elif bctype == 'zeropad':\\n        x_filt = np.concatenate([np.zeros((N, x.shape[1])), x], axis=0)\\n        trim = N\\n    else:\\n        x_filt = x.copy()\\n        trim = 0\\n\\n    # Gaussian kernel (matching MATLAB gausswin)\\n    kern = windows.gaussian(N, std=(N-1)/(2*2.5))  # MATLAB gausswin default alpha=2.5\\n\\n    # Make causal: zero out first half\\n    kern[:N//2] = 0\\n    kern = kern / kern.sum()\\n\\n    # Convolve\\n    out = np.zeros_like(x_filt)\\n    for j in range(x_filt.shape[1]):\\n        out[:, j] = np.convolve(x_filt[:, j], kern, mode='same')\\n\\n    out = out[trim:, :]\\n\\n    if was_1d:\\n        out = out[:, 0]\\n    return out\\n\\n\\ndef read_h5_string(f, ref):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Read a string from an HDF5 object reference.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    val = f[ref]\\n    chars = np.array(val).flatten()\\n    return ''.join(chr(int(c)) for c in chars)\\n\\n\\ndef get_cluster_qualities(f, clu_group):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Get quality labels for all clusters in a probe's cluster group.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    quality_refs = clu_group['quality']\\n    n_clusters = quality_refs.shape[0]\\n    qualities = []\\n    for i in range(n_clusters):\\n        ref = quality_refs[i, 0]\\n        q = read_h5_string(f, ref)\\n        qualities.append(q.strip().lower())\\n    return qualities\\n\\n\\ndef get_spike_data(f, clu_group, clu_idx):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Get spike trial numbers and trial times for a specific cluster.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    trial_ref = clu_group['trial'][clu_idx, 0]\\n    trial = np.array(f[trial_ref]).flatten()\\n\\n    trialtm_ref = clu_group['trialtm'][clu_idx, 0]\\n    trialtm = np.array(f[trialtm_ref]).flatten()\\n\\n    return trial, trialtm\\n\\n\\ndef compute_video_offset(f, obj):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute video offset matching findVideoOffset.m.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    bitStart = np.array(obj['bp']['ev']['bitStart']).flatten()\\n    sglx_bitstart = np.array(obj['sglx']['bitcode']['bitstart']).flatten()\\n    sglx_fs = float(np.array(obj['sglx']['fs']).flatten()[0])\\n\\n    bitStart_mode = float(stats.mode(bitStart, keepdims=False).mode)\\n    sglx_bitstart_mode = float(stats.mode(sglx_bitstart, keepdims=False).mode)\\n\\n    vidshift = sglx_bitstart_mode / sglx_fs - bitStart_mode\\n    return vidshift\\n\\n\\ndef get_traj_feature_names(f, traj_group, trial_idx=0):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Get feature names from trajectory data.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    feat_ref = traj_group['featNames'][trial_idx, 0]\\n    feat_data = f[feat_ref]\\n    names = []\\n    # Could be (1, n_feats) or (n_feats, 1)\\n    if feat_data.shape[0] == 1:\\n        for i in range(feat_data.shape[1]):\\n            ref = feat_data[0, i]\\n            names.append(read_h5_string(f, ref))\\n    else:\\n        for i in range(feat_data.shape[0]):\\n            ref = feat_data[i, 0]\\n            names.append(read_h5_string(f, ref))\\n    return names\\n\\n\\ndef compute_velocity_from_traj(f, traj_group, trial_idx, feat_idx, n_timepoints, gocue_time, vidshift, time_axis):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    Compute velocity of a tracked feature for a trial, interpolated to time_axis.\\n    Returns velocity as a 1D array aligned to time_axis.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    # Get frame times\\n    ft_ref = traj_group['frameTimes'][trial_idx, 0]\\n    frame_times = np.array(f[ft_ref]).flatten()\\n\\n    # Get tracking data: shape (n_features, 3, n_frames) where 3=[x,y,conf]\\n    ts_ref = traj_group['ts'][trial_idx, 0]\\n    ts = np.array(f[ts_ref])\\n\\n    # ts shape from HDF5 is (n_feats, 3, n_frames)\\n    x = ts[feat_idx, 0, :]  # x coordinate\\n    y = ts[feat_idx, 1, :]  # y coordinate\\n\\n    # Fill missing values with nearest (matching methods: \\\"Missing values were filled in\\n    # with the nearest available value for all features, except for the tongue\\\")\\n    # For tongue, we don't fill - but for velocity calculation we need to handle NaNs\\n\\n    # Compute velocity as first-order derivative\\n    # Velocity = sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2) / dt\\n    dt_vid = 1.0 / VIDEO_FPS\\n    dx = np.diff(x)\\n    dy = np.diff(y)\\n    vel = np.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2) / dt_vid\\n    vel_times = frame_times[:-1] + dt_vid / 2  # midpoint times\\n\\n    # Align to go cue: subtract vidshift and gocue_time\\n    vel_times_aligned = vel_times - vidshift - gocue_time\\n\\n    # Interpolate to time_axis\\n    try:\\n        vel_interp = np.interp(time_axis, vel_times_aligned, vel, left=np.nan, right=np.nan)\\n    except:\\n        vel_interp = np.full(len(time_axis), np.nan)\\n\\n    return vel_interp\\n\\n\\ndef load_motion_energy(data_dir, anm, date):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Load motion energy data from .mat file.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    me_fn = f'motionEnergy_{anm}_{date}.mat'\\n    me_path = os.path.join(DATA_ROOT, data_dir, me_fn)\\n\\n    if not os.path.exists(me_path):\\n        return None, None\\n\\n    try:\\n        me_mat = sio.loadmat(me_path, squeeze_me=False, struct_as_record=True)\\n        me = me_mat['me'][0, 0]\\n        thresh = float(me['moveThresh'].flatten()[0])\\n        data_field = me['data']\\n        # Handle nested struct: if me.data is itself a struct with 'data' field\\n        # (matching loadMotionEnergy.m: if isstruct(me.data); me.data = me.data.data; end)\\n        if data_field.dtype.names is not None and 'data' in data_field.dtype.names:\\n            data_field = data_field[0, 0]['data']\\n        data_arr = data_field.flatten()\\n        me_list = [data_arr[i].flatten().astype(float) for i in range(len(data_arr))]\\n        return me_list, thresh\\n    except:\\n        try:\\n            me_f = h5py.File(me_path, 'r')\\n            me = me_f['me']\\n            thresh = float(np.array(me['moveThresh']).flatten()[0])\\n            data_refs = me['data']\\n            me_data = []\\n            for i in range(data_refs.shape[0]):\\n                ref = data_refs[i, 0]\\n                d = np.array(me_f[ref]).flatten()\\n                me_data.append(d)\\n            me_f.close()\\n            return me_data, thresh\\n        except:\\n            return None, None\\n\\n\\ndef interpolate_me_to_time_axis(me_trial, frame_times, vidshift, gocue_time, time_axis):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Interpolate motion energy to time_axis, aligned to go cue.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    ft_aligned = frame_times - vidshift - gocue_time\\n    try:\\n        me_interp = np.interp(time_axis, ft_aligned, me_trial, left=np.nan, right=np.nan)\\n    except:\\n        me_interp = np.full(len(time_axis), np.nan)\\n    return me_interp\\n\\n\\n# ============================================================\\n# Main processing\\n# ============================================================\\n\\ndef process_session(anm, date, probe_nums, data_dir, time_edges, time_axis):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    Process a single session. Returns dict with neural, input, output data per trial,\\n    or None if session doesn't meet criteria.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    fn = f'data_structure_{anm}_{date}.mat'\\n    fpath = os.path.join(DATA_ROOT, data_dir, fn)\\n\\n    if not os.path.exists(fpath):\\n        print(f'  WARNING: File not found: {fpath}')\\n        return None\\n\\n    print(f'  Loading {anm}_{date} (probes {probe_nums})...')\\n\\n    f = h5py.File(fpath, 'r')\\n    obj = f['obj']\\n    bp = obj['bp']\\n\\n    # === Extract trial info ===\\n    ntrials = int(np.array(bp['Ntrials']).flatten()[0])\\n    hit = np.array(bp['hit']).flatten().astype(bool)\\n    miss = np.array(bp['miss']).flatten().astype(bool)\\n    no = np.array(bp['no']).flatten().astype(bool)\\n    R = np.array(bp['R']).flatten().astype(bool)\\n    L = np.array(bp['L']).flatten().astype(bool)\\n    autowater = np.array(bp['autowater']).flatten()\\n    early = np.array(bp['early']).flatten().astype(bool)\\n    stim_enable = np.array(bp['stim']['enable']).flatten().astype(bool)\\n\\n    gocue = np.array(bp['ev']['goCue']).flatten()\\n\\n    # === Trial selection (matching reference code conditions) ===\\n    # Include: hit or miss trials, no stim, no early lick\\n    # Exclude: ignore trials (no response), stim trials, early lick trials\\n    # Conditions from code:\\n    #   'R&hit&~stim.enable&~autowater&~early'  -> right correct DR\\n    #   'L&hit&~stim.enable&~autowater&~early'  -> left correct DR\\n    #   'R&miss&~stim.enable&~autowater&~early' -> right error DR\\n    #   'L&miss&~stim.enable&~autowater&~early' -> left error DR\\n    #   'R&hit&~stim.enable&autowater&~early'   -> right correct WC\\n    #   'L&hit&~stim.enable&autowater&~early'   -> left correct WC\\n    # We include all hit and miss trials (not ignore/no), excluding stim and early\\n    valid_trials = (hit | miss) & ~stim_enable & ~early\\n    valid_idx = np.where(valid_trials)[0]\\n\\n    if len(valid_idx) < 5:\\n        print(f'  WARNING: Too few valid trials ({len(valid_idx)}), skipping')\\n        f.close()\\n        return None\\n\\n    # === Extract cluster data from specified probes ===\\n    clu_ref = obj['clu']\\n    all_spike_trials = []\\n    all_spike_trialtm = []\\n    all_qualities = []\\n\\n    for probe_num in probe_nums:\\n        probe_idx = probe_num - 1  # 0-indexed\\n        try:\\n            ref = clu_ref[probe_idx, 0]\\n            clu_group = f[ref]\\n            if not isinstance(clu_group, h5py.Group):\\n                print(f'  WARNING: Probe {probe_num} has no cluster data, skipping probe')\\n                continue\\n        except:\\n            print(f'  WARNING: Cannot access probe {probe_num}, skipping probe')\\n            continue\\n\\n        qualities = get_cluster_qualities(f, clu_group)\\n        n_clu = len(qualities)\\n\\n        for i in range(n_clu):\\n            q = qualities[i]\\n            if q in EXCLUDE_QUALITIES:\\n                continue\\n            trial, trialtm = get_spike_data(f, clu_group, i)\\n            all_spike_trials.append(trial)\\n            all_spike_trialtm.append(trialtm)\\n            all_qualities.append(q)\\n\\n    if len(all_spike_trials) == 0:\\n        print(f'  WARNING: No valid clusters found, skipping')\\n        f.close()\\n        return None\\n\\n    n_units = len(all_spike_trials)\\n\\n    # === Align spikes to go cue and bin ===\\n    n_timebins = len(time_axis)\\n\\n    # Single trial firing rates: (n_units, n_timebins, n_trials)\\n    trialdat = np.zeros((n_units, n_timebins, ntrials))\\n\\n    for i in range(n_units):\\n        trial_nums = all_spike_trials[i]\\n        spike_times = all_spike_trialtm[i]\\n\\n        for j in range(ntrials):\\n            trial_mask = (trial_nums == (j + 1))  # trials are 1-indexed in MATLAB\\n            if not np.any(trial_mask):\\n                continue\\n\\n            spk_times = spike_times[trial_mask]\\n            # Align to go cue\\n            aligned_times = spk_times - gocue[j]\\n\\n            # Bin spikes\\n            counts, _ = np.histogram(aligned_times, bins=time_edges)\\n            # Convert to firing rate and smooth\\n            fr = counts / DT\\n            fr_smooth = causal_gaussian_smooth(fr, SMOOTH_WINDOW, BC_TYPE)\\n            trialdat[i, :, j] = fr_smooth\\n\\n    # === Remove low firing rate units ===\\n    # Mean FR across all time bins and all trials (matching removeLowFRClusters.m)\\n    # The reference computes mean of the PSTH (trial-averaged), but we approximate\\n    # by computing mean across all time and trials\\n    mean_frs = np.mean(np.mean(trialdat[:, :, valid_idx], axis=2), axis=1)\\n    keep_units = mean_frs > LOW_FR_THRESH\\n\\n    if keep_units.sum() < 10:\\n        print(f'  WARNING: Only {keep_units.sum()} units with FR > {LOW_FR_THRESH} Hz (need >= 10), skipping')\\n        f.close()\\n        return None\\n\\n    trialdat = trialdat[keep_units, :, :]\\n    n_units_final = trialdat.shape[0]\\n    print(f'  {n_units_final} units after filtering (from {n_units} total)')\\n\\n    # === Compute video offset ===\\n    vidshift = compute_video_offset(f, obj)\\n\\n    # === Load trajectory data for tongue and paw velocity ===\\n    traj_ref = obj['traj']\\n\\n    # Bottom cam for tongue and paw\\n    bottom_ref = traj_ref[1, 0]\\n    bottom_traj = f[bottom_ref]\\n    bottom_feats = get_traj_feature_names(f, bottom_traj, 0)\\n    # Find tongue feature index (top_tongue) and paw feature index (top_paw or bottom_paw)\\n    tongue_feat_idx = None\\n    paw_feat_idx = None\\n    for idx, name in enumerate(bottom_feats):\\n        if name == 'top_tongue':\\n            tongue_feat_idx = idx\\n        if name == 'bottom_paw':\\n            paw_feat_idx = idx\\n    if tongue_feat_idx is None:\\n        # Fall back to any tongue feature\\n        for idx, name in enumerate(bottom_feats):\\n            if 'tongue' in name.lower():\\n                tongue_feat_idx = idx\\n                break\\n    if paw_feat_idx is None:\\n        for idx, name in enumerate(bottom_feats):\\n            if 'paw' in name.lower():\\n                paw_feat_idx = idx\\n                break\\n\\n    # === Load motion energy ===\\n    me_data, me_thresh = load_motion_energy(data_dir, anm, date)\\n\\n    # === Process each valid trial ===\\n    neural_trials = []\\n    input_trials = []\\n    output_trials = []\\n    trial_indices_used = []\\n\\n    for trial_idx in valid_idx:\\n        # Neural data for this trial\\n        neural = trialdat[:, :, trial_idx]  # (n_units, n_timebins)\\n\\n        # Input: time from go cue (same for all trials)\\n        input_data = time_axis.reshape(1, -1).copy()  # (1, n_timebins)\\n\\n        # === Output variables ===\\n        # Lick direction: left=0, right=1\\n        lick_dir = 1 if R[trial_idx] else 0\\n\\n        # Behavioral context: WC=0, DR=1\\n        context = 0 if autowater[trial_idx] == 1 else 1\\n\\n        # Outcome: incorrect=0, correct=1\\n        outcome = 1 if hit[trial_idx] else 0\\n\\n        # Tongue velocity (time-varying)\\n        if tongue_feat_idx is not None:\\n            tongue_vel = compute_velocity_from_traj(\\n                f, bottom_traj, trial_idx, tongue_feat_idx,\\n                n_timebins, gocue[trial_idx], vidshift, time_axis\\n            )\\n        else:\\n            tongue_vel = np.full(n_timebins, np.nan)\\n\\n        # Paw velocity (time-varying)\\n        if paw_feat_idx is not None:\\n            paw_vel = compute_velocity_from_traj(\\n                f, bottom_traj, trial_idx, paw_feat_idx,\\n                n_timebins, gocue[trial_idx], vidshift, time_axis\\n            )\\n        else:\\n            paw_vel = np.full(n_timebins, np.nan)\\n\\n        # Motion energy (time-varying)\\n        if me_data is not None:\\n            # Get frame times for this trial\\n            ft_ref = bottom_traj['frameTimes'][trial_idx, 0]\\n            frame_times = np.array(f[ft_ref]).flatten()\\n            me_trial = me_data[trial_idx]\\n            me_interp = interpolate_me_to_time_axis(\\n                me_trial, frame_times, vidshift, gocue[trial_idx], time_axis\\n            )\\n        else:\\n            me_interp = np.full(n_timebins, np.nan)\\n\\n        neural_trials.append(neural)\\n        input_trials.append(input_data)\\n\\n        # Store raw continuous values; discretization happens per-session after all trials\\n        output_trials.append({\\n            'lick_dir': lick_dir,\\n            'context': context,\\n            'outcome': outcome,\\n            'tongue_vel': tongue_vel,\\n            'paw_vel': paw_vel,\\n            'motion_energy': me_interp,\\n        })\\n        trial_indices_used.append(trial_idx)\\n\\n    f.close()\\n\\n    if len(neural_trials) < 2:\\n        print(f'  WARNING: Only {len(neural_trials)} valid trials, need at least 2, skipping')\\n        return None\\n\\n    # === Discretize continuous outputs per session ===\\n    # Collect all tongue_vel, paw_vel, motion_energy across trials for percentile\\n    all_tongue = np.concatenate([t['tongue_vel'] for t in output_trials])\\n    all_paw = np.concatenate([t['paw_vel'] for t in output_trials])\\n    all_me = np.concatenate([t['motion_energy'] for t in output_trials])\\n\\n    # Remove NaNs for percentile computation\\n    tongue_thresh = np.nanpercentile(all_tongue, 50) if not np.all(np.isnan(all_tongue)) else 0\\n    paw_thresh = np.nanpercentile(all_paw, 50) if not np.all(np.isnan(all_paw)) else 0\\n    me_thresh_50 = np.nanpercentile(all_me, 50) if not np.all(np.isnan(all_me)) else 0\\n\\n    # Build final output arrays\\n    final_output_trials = []\\n    for t in output_trials:\\n        tongue_disc = np.where(np.isnan(t['tongue_vel']), 0,\\n                              np.where(t['tongue_vel'] >= tongue_thresh, 1, 0)).astype(np.int64)\\n        paw_disc = np.where(np.isnan(t['paw_vel']), 0,\\n                           np.where(t['paw_vel'] >= paw_thresh, 1, 0)).astype(np.int64)\\n        me_disc = np.where(np.isnan(t['motion_energy']), 0,\\n                          np.where(t['motion_energy'] >= me_thresh_50, 1, 0)).astype(np.int64)\\n\\n        # Output array: (6, n_timebins) for time-varying, or (6,) for per-trial\\n        # lick_dir, context, outcome are per-trial (scalar)\\n        # tongue_vel, paw_vel, motion_energy are time-varying\\n        out = np.zeros((6, n_timebins), dtype=np.int64)\\n        out[0, :] = t['lick_dir']\\n        out[1, :] = t['context']\\n        out[2, :] = t['outcome']\\n        out[3, :] = tongue_disc\\n        out[4, :] = paw_disc\\n        out[5, :] = me_disc\\n\\n        final_output_trials.append(out)\\n\\n    return {\\n        'neural': neural_trials,\\n        'input': input_trials,\\n        'output': final_output_trials,\\n        'n_units': n_units_final,\\n        'anm': anm,\\n        'date': date,\\n        'n_trials': len(neural_trials),\\n        'n_valid_total': len(valid_idx),\\n    }\\n\\n\\ndef main(output_file='converted_data.pkl', sample_file='sample_data.pkl'):\\n    # Time bin edges and centers\\n    time_edges = np.arange(TMIN, TMAX + DT, DT)\\n    time_axis = time_edges[:-1] + DT / 2\\n    n_timebins = len(time_axis)\\n\\n    print(f'Time axis: {n_timebins} bins, {TMIN} to {TMAX} s, dt={DT*1000:.0f} ms')\\n\\n    # Check which sessions actually exist\\n    available_sessions = []\\n    for anm, date, probes, data_dir in EPHYS_SESSIONS:\\n        fn = f'data_structure_{anm}_{date}.mat'\\n        fpath = os.path.join(DATA_ROOT, data_dir, fn)\\n        if os.path.exists(fpath):\\n            available_sessions.append((anm, date, probes, data_dir))\\n        else:\\n            print(f'  Skipping {anm}_{date}: file not found')\\n\\n    print(f'\\\\nFound {len(available_sessions)} session files')\\n\\n    # Process all sessions\\n    all_sessions = []\\n    subjects_set = []\\n\\n    for anm, date, probes, data_dir in available_sessions:\\n        result = process_session(anm, date, probes, data_dir, time_edges, time_axis)\\n        if result is not None:\\n            all_sessions.append(result)\\n            if anm not in subjects_set:\\n                subjects_set.append(anm)\\n\\n    print(f'\\\\nProcessed {len(all_sessions)} sessions from {len(subjects_set)} subjects')\\n\\n    # === Build final data structure ===\\n    subjects = subjects_set\\n    subject_idx = np.array([subjects.index(s['anm']) for s in all_sessions])\\n\\n    # Brain regions: all ALM\\n    brain_regions = ['ALM']\\n    brain_region_idx = [np.zeros(s['n_units'], dtype=np.int64) for s in all_sessions]\\n\\n    # Assemble lists\\n    neural = [s['neural'] for s in all_sessions]\\n    inputs = [s['input'] for s in
